title: How is Donald Trump connected to Julius Caesar?
description:
A Vatican visit, the line of popes, a Renaissance fresco and Rome's first emperors connect Donald Trump to Julius Caesar.

Donald Trump → Pope Francis → Saint Peter → Nero → Julius Caesar

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Donald Trump → Pope Francis: In May 2017, President Donald Trump visited Pope Francis at the Vatican.
   Photo by Shealeah Craighead, CC BY 3.0 us: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Donald_Trump_Pope_Francis_Melania_Trump_in_2017.jpg
2. Pope Francis → Saint Peter (10 portraits, every holder): Francis was the 266th pope, in an unbroken line of popes running back to Saint Peter.
   Photo, unknown / CC BY-SA 3.0 / Public domain / CC0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Francis_Korea_Haemi_Castle_19_(4x5_cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ADAMELLO_-_PAPA_-_Giovanni_Paolo_II_-_panoramio_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pius_XII_with_tabard,_by_Michael_Pitcairn,_1951_(retouched).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pius_IX,_by_Adolphe_Braun,_1875.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_of_Pope_Alexander_VI_Borgia_(Vatican_Museums_-_Musei_Vaticani,_Vatican).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pedro_Berruguete_-_Portrait_of_Pope_Sixtus_IV_della_Rovere_-_1916.815_-_Cleveland_Museum_of_ArtFXD.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Innocent_III_(Monastery_of_Subiaco).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Exultet_Rolls_of_Southern_Italy,_detail_of_Pope_Gregory_VII.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Herrera_mozo_San_Le%C3%B3n_magno_Lienzo._%C3%93valo._164_x_105_cm._Museo_del_Prado.png + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:St._Peter_(portrayed_as_a_Roman_consul).jpg
3. Saint Peter → Nero: Around 1482, Filippino Lippi painted Saint Peter on trial before the Roman emperor Nero.
   Photo by see filename or category, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cappella_brancacci,_Disputa_di_Simon_Mago_(restaurato),_Filippino_Lippi.jpg
4. Nero → Julius Caesar (6 portraits, every holder): And Nero was the last emperor of the dynasty that began with Julius Caesar and his heir Augustus.
   Photo, Public domain / CC BY 2.5 / CC BY-SA 2.0 / Attribution / CC BY-SA 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nero_Glyptothek_Munich_321.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Claudius_crop.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Caligula.Carlsberg_Glyptotek.(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:8095_-_Roma_-_Ara_Pacis_-_Tiberio_-_Foto_Giovanni_Dall%27Orto_-_28-Mar-2008.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Augustus_of_Prima_Porta.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Retrato_de_Julio_C%C3%A9sar_(26724093101)_(cropped).jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
